items.name: Drowned Captain's Lantern
items.lore: Won from the Drowned Captain when The Rising Tide was ended. It burns under water.

items.name: Big Donncha's Toll-Chain
items.lore: Won from Big Donncha when The Toll at Daigean Bridge was ended. Heavy, and very shiny.

items.name: Hazel-Warden's Crown
items.lore: Won from the Hazel-Warden when The Hazel Harvest was ended. Hazel leaves that never fall.

items.name: Arracht's Scale
items.lore: Won from Arracht when The Serpent Upriver was ended. A single scale, big as a shield, cut down to fit.

items.name: Wave of Sinann's Pearl
items.lore: Won from the Wave of Sinann when The Well Wakes was ended. It's wet, always.

items.name: Saltmarsh Spyglass
items.lore: Won from Captain Edric Saltmarsh when The Albion Landing was beaten. Albion brass. Hibernian coast in the lens.
